subject: Request: Riverbend night-window bonus for POC throughput validation
messages:
From: Sohini Patel <sohini@riverbend.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>; sales@redwood.ai
Cc: Tomas Alvarez <tomas@riverbend.ai>
Date: Mon, 8 Mar 2027 18:12:00 -0700
Subject: Night-window POC: request for short-term capacity bonus

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo today — the model latency at small scale looks promising. We need to run a 12-hour overnight soak to validate tail latencies and concurrency behaviour for our edge use-case (target 4k RPS simulated with synthetic traffic). Our cloud budget is constrained for the pilot; would Redwood be willing to provision a short-term credits/bonus for the night-window so we can complete the latency p95/p99 sweep?

Attached is a short plan (Riverbend_POC_load_plan.xlsx) with the traffic profile and telemetry expectations. We'd run from 00:00–12:00 PT on Wed night-into-Thu morning. Key asks: ~75k token budget, ability to pin a dedicated smaller VM pool for the slot, and an SLA-ish window in case we hit unexpected throttling.

If you can confirm a provisional uplift today, we can lock the window and share contract details.

Thanks,
Sohini Patel
Director of Engineering, Riverbend AI
sohini@riverbend.ai

Suggested: provisional promo credits and a short Dedicated slot (pin for 12 hours) with on-call ops during the window. Can Sales Ops cover the billing exemption for a one-off promotional top-up and flag the deal for review? If we approve, I’ll confirm the slot and ask Eng to reserve a pool.

Quick answers:
- Start: Wed 00:00 PT (2027-03-10 07:00 UTC)
- Duration: 12 hours
- Token estimate: 75k (they attached the traffic mix)

Thanks — Marissa

Marissa — thanks for the ping. A one-off promo top-up is plausible; I need to run numbers with Sales Ops (copied) and confirm capacity availability with infra. Two quick clarifications I’ll ask the customer:

1) Can they share a hard p95/p99 target matrix (we saw p95 target in the plan but not p99).
2) Do they need persistent pinning for the whole 12 hours or is a warm-start + burst policy OK?

If Sales Ops approves an exception, we can offer: 80k tokens promo credit + ops cover for a pinned pool for the slot. I’ll follow up with infra on potential contention with scheduled maintenance windows.

—Ben

Hi Marissa / Ben — thanks for the quick reply. Answers below:

1) p95 target: <= 90 ms; p99 target: <= 320 ms (we need to show both for our performance team).
2) We prefer a pinned pool for consistency. Warm-start + burst has more variability for the p99 tail in our prior tests.

We can be flexible on token accounting; if you provide a provisional top-up and we exceed it, we can agree to a short reconciliation or pay for overage.

Tomas (copied) will coordinate the telemetry hooks.

—Sohini
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Sohini Patel <sohini@riverbend.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, sales-ops@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 9 Mar 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Night-window POC: request for short-term capacity bonus

Hi Sohini — happy to help. We’ll provision an 80k token promotional credit and reserve a small dedicated pool for your 00:00–12:00 PT slot on Wed (2027-03-10). Sales Ops, please treat this as a one-off promotional uplift against RB-POC-2027-42; infra: please mark the pool pinned from 2027-03-10T00:00:00-07:00 to 2027-03-10T12:00:00-07:00 and route monitoring to on-call.

Notes and conditions:
- Promo credit covers expected token usage up to 80k tokens. Any overage will be billed at standard trial overage rates unless Sales Ops signs off otherwise.
- We require a short telemetry callback (s3 or drive link) within 48 hours post-run so we can inspect p95/p99 traces for model behaviour regressions.
- If the run shows blocking reliability issues on our side (e.g., sustained p99 > 500 ms), we’ll follow our incident escalation playbook; this promo is not an SLA contract.

Sohini — once you confirm, I’ll ask Sales Ops to push the credit and Infra to reserve capacity. Good luck with the sweep.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
